# `company.document_line_identities`

Stable entered-line identities; identities omitted by later revisions are never reused.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + id | — | — | Stable ULID of this immutable record. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this history record was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this history record. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this history record. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + id | — | transactions.id | Document that permanently owns this line identity. |
